messages:
Iris (Revenue Ops): Quick PSA before close  control check found: several monthly credits were wired to 'one-time discounts' GL during invoice generation. Need to confirm treatment for month-end.
Caleb (Billing): Which credits / SKUs?
Iris (Revenue Ops): SKUs: MONTHLY-TRIAL-CREDIT and LAUNCH-INCENTIVE. Sample invoices: INV-13001 (PolarGrid) $12,000, INV-13005 (IotaCloud) $3,600, INV-13008 (Zenith) $2,400. All intended to be amortized over 12 months.
Marta (Accounting): Did billing map them to GL 4100 (Discounts) again?
Caleb (Billing): Yep, mapping file shows GL=4100 for those SKUs. That was the fallback rule.
Ravi (Controller): Materiality: PolarGrid >10k but under 25k threshold. Still, we should treat consistently and document.
Iris (Revenue Ops): Exported amort schedule shows remaining as of 4/30: PolarGrid 11,000 (11/12), IotaCloud 3,300, Zenith 2,200. Here's the CSV: https://drive.google.com/file/d/monthly-credit-export (view).
Marta (Accounting): Proposed per-invoice JE to reclassify remaining balances as of 4/30:
```
DR 4100 Sales Discounts 16,500
CR 2380 Deferred Revenue - Promotions 16,500
Memo: Reclass MONTHLY-TRIAL-CREDIT / LAUNCH-INCENTIVE to deferred revenue; attach export and invoice refs.
```
Iris (Revenue Ops): I'll create billing ticket BC-4512 to change default routing for these SKUs to deferred GL and add unit tests.
Caleb (Billing): adding validation rule: if SKU contains "MONTHLY" or "LAUNCH-INCENTIVE" -> GL 2380. Will open PR and link ticket.
close-bot: Reminder: any reclassification >$15k should be noted in close commentary.
Ravi (Controller): Noted. Even though PolarGrid <25k, combined impact is >15k so include note. Also check tax impact (looping in Tax separately).
Marta (Accounting): I'll post JEs today: JE-580201 (PolarGrid), JE-580202 (IotaCloud), JE-580203 (Zenith). Will include invoice numbers and amort schedule.
Iris (Revenue Ops): Billing ticket BC-4512 created, owner -> @caleb. PR link: BC-PR-978.
Caleb (Billing): CI green, staging deploy tonight. Unit test added to ensure deferral mapping exists.
Elaine (CFO): Reviewed. Approve reclass entries and the control fix. Please include one-line audit rationale: "Credits represent prepayment/consideration for future service and are recognized ratably over term per revenue policy."
Marta (Accounting): Adding audit rationale to JE memos. Will circulate updated revenue rollforward in close pack once JEs post.
close-bot: NetSuite JEs posted: NS-JE-580201..580203. Month-end pack updated.
